items.name: Please Be Quiet UCLA 2017

venue.name: [University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)](http://www.ucla.edu/)
venue.address: 345 Portola Plaza, Los Angeles, CA 90095, USA

items.information: This competition is being organized by Cubing Club at UCLA. All UCLA students may register free of charge; the fee is $10 for everyone else. There will be a competitor limit of 30, and no walk-in registrations. Spectators may attend for free, but must be quiet as the events being held require a lot of concentration on the part of the competitors. If you are a UCLA student looking to attend a local competition but can't do the blindfolded events, note that we hope to hold another competition later in the year with more standard events such as 3x3x3. Don't be afraid to show up and spectate for a bit! **Please note that no food is allowed in the classroom.**
